StableHomotopyKTheory.title: Algebraic topology of spaces and manifolds, Part II: homotopy foundations for algebraic K-theory
StableHomotopyKTheory.reason: Make AlgebraicTopology the first roadmap prerequisite. Its ordinary chains, local coefficients, CW/cofibration, Serre and homotopy-comparison interfaces remain unchanged. Build classifying-space comparisons, homotopy fibres and Quillen A/B, plus/group completion and concrete spectra beyond them; retain all 12 stage IDs, the reviewed decomposition and every consumer. Preserve stage-level early/late splits, not a whole-roadmap dependency on all of GeneralAlgebraicKTheory or the late EDS comparison.

StableHomotopyKTheory:H.1.keeps: Compose the existing nerve and realization functors to obtain classifying spaces, then prove natural-transformation homotopies, categorical-equivalence/adjoint/contractibility lemmas, product comparison under the finite-factor or compactly generated hypotheses, and filtered-diagram compatibility. Keep the CW structure on realizations, the category-specific covering/local-system and fundamental-group comparisons, BG/bar identification and K(G,1) realization with induced maps, bar/singular homology comparison with arbitrary local coefficients, and all three original tests. Import ordinary local systems, twisted chains, van Kampen, CW and Whitehead machinery; do not construct another nerve, realization or universal cover.
StableHomotopyKTheory:H.1.reason: Separate already-built carriers and anchor-owned ordinary topology from the genuinely new category-to-space comparisons. The reviewed H.1 nodes stay at their current IDs and retain these imports and their unread proof boundaries.

StableHomotopyKTheory:H.2.keeps: Construct path-space homotopy fibres and pullbacks, their maps and path-dependent transport, the fibre long exact sequence including pointed-set end terms, Quillen A/B with their different comma-category/transition hypotheses, the quasi-fibration lemma, bisimplicial diagonal/iterated realization and the separately required levelwise-equivalence theorem. Import Kan homotopy groups and their cubical/singular comparison, the based-pair interface and ordinary basepoint transport. Use the anchor's Serre-fibration carrier and prove path-replacement/fibre comparisons to it where needed; neither the pair LES nor Serre's homology spectral sequence substitutes for the fibre LES.
StableHomotopyKTheory:H.2.reason: The AT8 overlap is an exact import; the AT5 lead is a shared carrier and compatibility boundary, not ownership of all homotopy-fibre mathematics. Quasi-fibrations must not silently acquire Serre lifting.

StableHomotopyKTheory:H.3.keeps: Construct plus for connected CW-type spaces and perfect normal subgroups by 2/3-cell attachments, including the quotient fundamental group, all pulled-back quotient local-coefficient homology isomorphisms, acyclicity, the appropriately qualified universal property and uniqueness, functoriality with subgroup data, and relative/fibre comparison. Keep the generic plus/central-extension consequences and all tests in the integrated packet. Apply imported Hurewicz, Whitehead, CW/cofibration, excision, van Kampen, covering and Serre results; do not reprove them. Preserve the obstruction-theory, local-coefficient acyclicity and relative-plus source gaps.
StableHomotopyKTheory:H.3.reason: The Hurewicz test is an application of AT8, not a second Hurewicz theorem. AT5 now names the previously missing Serre supplier, but applications must still verify its coefficient, base and convergence hypotheses.

StableHomotopyKTheory:H.4.keeps: Construct homotopy group completion from the maximal subgroupoid using S-inverse-S/Gamma or an explicit equivalent model, its comparison of pi0 with the existing algebraic group completion/split K0, homology localization and cofinal stabilization. Retain the general cofinality theorem and its projective-module group-completion-to-BGL-plus comparison, with component and ring-map/block-sum naturality, countability/phantom restrictions where used and no natural product splitting. Retain coherence or strictification-independence proofs for the homotopy construction. Import algebraic K0, projective complements, stable GL/elementary/perfectness results, and plus. The comparison from Q(Proj) to this completion remains K.2:plus.
StableHomotopyKTheory:H.4.reason: The reviewed H.4 -> K.2:plus handoff already selects the correct owner for cofinal homotopy stabilization. Algebraic complements and K0 are separate suppliers; no reverse K.2:plus prerequisite is introduced.

StableHomotopyKTheory:H.5.reason: Keep the parent ID and both child prerequisites as an aggregation/reexport, not a third spectrum construction. Its late return to EDS E5:spectra-comparison remains intact.

StableHomotopyKTheory:H.5:spectra.keeps: Construct the concrete simplicial-compatible spectrum model, suspension spectra, loops/shifts, integer-indexed homotopy groups and stable equivalences, functorial replacements, stable homotopy category and spectrum fibre/cofibre LES. Verify stability, shifts/signs and finite biproducts in this model using the abstract EDS interface. Keep Eilenberg-Mac Lane spectra from chain complexes, their homotopy/cohomology comparison and functorial truncations. Locate the generic concrete smash product, induced homotopy-group pairing and needed concrete operadic/E-infinity realization here, reexporting them through H.5:S-delooping. Do not import the late EDS comparison or define abstract stable/monoidal categories again.
StableHomotopyKTheory:H.5:spectra.reason: Deduplicate abstract category theory while retaining its model-level realization obligations. Generic smash is the early spectrum infrastructure already demanded by RefinedTraceMethods, not an S-construction-specific operation; moving its ownership within H.5 preserves all old exports.

StableHomotopyKTheory:H.5:S-delooping.keeps: Assemble the iterated Waldhausen S-construction as a connective spectrum in the H.5:spectra model and prove the model/indexing/naturality comparisons, using the additivity, relative-S fibration and delooping theorem supplied by K.4:construction. Reexport the concrete smash/pairing interface from H.5:spectra and apply the EDS operadic framework only in the proved setting. The actual biexact-functor external K-theory product, its coherences and relative/localization compatibility belong to K.7, which consumes these spectrum interfaces, not conversely. Keep the existing integrated node as the spectrum assembly/comparison and preserve its incoming proof link.
StableHomotopyKTheory:H.5:S-delooping.reason: A sequence of spaces does not prove delooping. Assign the fibration/delooping proof once to the early K.4:construction supplier, retain the later assembly here, and never require K.4's aggregate or K.7 as input to this stage. Required integration alignment: keep the IDs GeneralAlgebraicKTheory:K.4/waldhausen-additivity-theorem and GeneralAlgebraicKTheory:K.4/relative-S-construction-fibration-and-delooping, but set both parentStageId values to GeneralAlgebraicKTheory:K.4:construction. Their current late K.4 parents contradict their incoming/outgoing proof links. Preserve all those links and source gaps; see the report's exact migration table.

StableHomotopyKTheory:H.6.keeps: Construct spectrum cofibres E/m, their Bockstein maps and exact sequences in all integer degrees without assuming a splitting; the actual E/p^r tower and homotopy limit; the spectrum Milnor sequence and map-level naturality; its reduction under proved module-level Mittag-Leffler/lim1 conditions; finiteness and Tate-term hypotheses for tensor-with-Z_p comparisons; filtered-spectrum exact couples, differentials and convergence with explicit completeness/boundedness/connectivity; rationalization and bounded-below arithmetic fracture. Compare the ordinary Eilenberg-Mac Lane/CW filtration case with AT4's existing skeletal construction, without reconstructing it. Preserve nonzero torsion and nonzero lim1 tests, and compare the module/complex specialization with the established arithmetic derived-limit interface rather than identifying complexes with all spectra.
StableHomotopyKTheory:H.6.reason: AT4 is the fixed ordinary special case, not a supplier of spectrum convergence. R02.1 supplies module-level limit criteria; D7 owns the compact-cochain derived extension and CC.2 its arithmetic tower application. H.6 still owes the spectrum homotopy-limit construction and compatibility proofs.
